name: Okashi na Shima no Peter Pan ~Sweet Never Land~
original_name: お菓子な島のピーターパン ～Sweet Never Land～
source:
There is a strange place called Neverland and every year they hold a baking competition and 3 children are taken from a different world to judge it.

It is Peter Pan's job to go and look for 3 children who really like cake. When searching for judges, Peter Pan meets Wendy and falls in love with her at first sight and , avoiding the advice of Tinker Bell, he decides to make her and her two non-blood related brothers the three judges.However, Wendy's two brothers actually don't like cake very much even though they agreed to go along with her.

What will happen to Wendy in this strange new world?
translation:
有一个名为Neverland的奇异世界，每年都会举办烘焙比赛，并从异世界带来三名孩子担任评委。

彼得潘的任务是寻找三名真正喜欢蛋糕的孩子。他在物色评委时遇见Wendy，对她一见钟情；尽管Tinker Bell提出反对，他仍决定让Wendy和她两个没有血缘关系的兄弟担任三名评委。然而，Wendy的两个兄弟其实并不怎么喜欢蛋糕，只是同意陪她一起来。

Wendy在这个陌生的新世界会有怎样的遭遇？
